subject: Business Models
title: Amazon: Store to Platform to Cloud
description: A short lesson to help you apply Amazon: Store to Platform to Cloud.

hook.text: Amazon started selling books. Its most profitable unit is now cloud computing. That's a triple pivot.

buildup.text: Amazon went from bookstore to everything-store to marketplace (third-party sellers) to cloud infrastructure provider.

discovery.text: AWS started as internal infrastructure. Amazon realized it could sell excess capacity to other companies.

twist.text: AWS generates more operating profit than Amazon's entire retail business combined. The side project became the core.

climax.text: Amazon's willingness to pivot repeatedly—and bet on adjacencies—created a $1.5 trillion company.

punchline.text: Books to cloud servers. Amazon's best business was an accident.

quiz.question: How did AWS originate?
options: Amazon sold excess internal infrastructure capacity
A competitor forced them to build it
